(6.17) (p. 106), c_ann(beta) = -2 log q / log[1 - (1 - e^-beta)/q], at beta -> oo, where the annealed (first-moment) entropy of proper 3-colorings of G(N, M = cN/2) vanishes. (6.17) and (6.24): the page names this number c_ann, the ANNEALED threshold (2 ln 3/ln(3/2) = 5.419), not the colorability threshold c_col(q = 3) (Ch. 14, task K7; not banked here). coloring_c_ann_q3.independent_route: the exact first moment E Z of 3-colorings over G(N, M) (coloring/first_moment.py: a composition sum, checked against brute-force enumeration of every graph and coloring at N = 5); (1/N) ln E Z changes sign between c = 5.3 and 5.5 at N = 120 and, at c = 3, approaches the annealed form at O(1/N) over N = 30, 60, 120 (the gap halves per doubling of N, as tests/test_potts_coloring.py asserts; a polynomial prefactor of E Z would add an O(log N / N) term, not resolved at these sizes)
